evidence.note: QuRL accelerates RL training for LLM reasoning by using a quantized (INT8/FP8) actor for the rollout phase -- which consumes up to 70% of total RL training time -- introducing Adaptive Clipping Range to prevent instability from the full-precision/quantized-actor mismatch and an invariant scaling technique for small inter-step weight updates, achieving 20-80% faster rollout on DeepScaleR and DAPO.
evidence.title: QuRL: Low-Precision Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Reasoning

name: invariant scaling for small weight updates
